name: Starfall Palm
description: Bring a palm down from above with a bright falling point of starlight at its heel.

name: Starfall Ward
description: Hold up an overhead plane of falling starlight that breaks and turns a blow from above.

name: Starfall Stride
description: Drop from a half-leap in a long stride that lands light on a trail of falling sparks.

name: Starfall Strike
description: Fall on the foe with a heavy blow that carries a bright streak of starlight down the arm.

name: Starfall Dart
description: Throw a single dart of falling light that strikes from above before the foe can raise his guard.

name: Starfall Mend
description: Let a slow fall of soft starlight settle on an injury and ease it in yourself or an ally.

name: Starfall Rain
description: Call a rain of star-bright bolts down on the field that strikes every foe in a wide ring.

name: Starfall Shell
description: Cast a dome of falling light over yourself and your allies that dims a heavy blow to nothing.

name: Starfall Descent
description: Call one great mass of starlight down upon the field in a single crushing descent.

name: Astrolabe Fist
description: Throw a fist along the exact line the dial of qi shows between the fist and the target.

name: Astrolabe Ward
description: Set the rings of qi round the body at the angle the blow will come and meet it there.

name: Astrolabe Step
description: Turn the body on its rings to a new angle and step exactly along the new line.

name: Astrolabe Turn
description: Spin a ring of qi against the blow so it is carried round and away from the body.

name: Astrolabe Sight
description: Read the angle and height of every foe in the field from the rings of starlit qi.

name: Astrolabe Pierce
description: Align the rings on the foe's weakest line and drive a thin point of qi down it.

name: Astrolabe Draw
description: Align the ally's qi with the rings and lend a measure of starlit force for several breaths.

name: Astrolabe Volley
description: Set every ring true and loose bolts of starlight that all fall on the one point sighted.

name: Astrolabe Hold
description: Pin the foe in the aligned rings so his qi cannot leave the angle he stands at.

name: Astrolabe Reckoning
description: Cast the full rings over the field to show every foe and lend your allies strength and sight.

name: Supernova Palm
description: Strike with a palm swollen with bright qi that flares at the very moment of contact.

name: Supernova Ward
description: Swell a bright shell round the body that bursts outward and blunts the blow it meets.

name: Supernova Stride
description: Burst off the planted foot on a flare of qi and carry the body three paces on it.

name: Supernova Turn
description: Flare the forearm as a blow arrives so its own brightness throws the strike aside.

name: Supernova Spark
description: Fling a spark of the heart's bright qi that bursts on the foe in a small searing flash.

name: Supernova Dazzle
description: Flash the swollen heart at the foe's eyes so he is blind for several breaths.

name: Supernova Mend
description: Pour a gentle share of the heart's brightness into a wound and seal it in yourself or an ally.

name: Supernova Ring
description: Send a bright ring outward from the body that scorches every foe it crosses.

name: Supernova Cloak
description: Wrap a cloak of dense bright qi about the body that burns off the weight of heavy blows.

name: Supernova Burst
description: Swell the heart to its peak and loose all of it at once in a blinding burst over the field.

name: Stardust Palm
description: Strike with a palm trailing fine glittering dust that stings the eyes of the one struck.

name: Stardust Ward
description: Scatter a curtain of fine dust before the body that thins a blow to a drifting haze.

name: Stardust Step
description: Break into a brief trail of dust at the end of each step and reform a pace on.

name: Stardust Turn
description: Let the forearm go to dust as a strike arrives and re-form behind it so the blow passes.

name: Stardust Reading
description: Loose a fine dust of qi into the field and read the foes by where it settles.

name: Stardust Blind
description: Blow a fan of glittering dust into the foe's face that blinds and spoils his aim.

name: Stardust Pierce
description: Gather the dust into one hard point and drive it through the guard.

name: Stardust Cleanse
description: Pass a fine dust of starlight through the blood to scour a taint from yourself or an ally.

name: Stardust Shroud
description: Wrap the body in a shroud of drifting dust that scatters strikes and hides the form.

name: Stardust Spray
description: Fling a wide spray of burning dust that cuts every foe near and fouls their sight.

name: Stardust Flash
description: Dissolve the body into dust and reform in the same breath beside the foe or far behind him.

name: Beacon Palm
description: Strike with a palm that burns steady as a beacon and brands the point of contact with light.

name: Beacon Guard
description: Hold the guard lit like a beacon so a blow is checked by the glare as well as the qi.

name: Beacon Step
description: Advance on a steady lit line so that any ally behind can step in the same place.

name: Beacon Sight
description: Kindle a beacon that shows every ally and foe near as a lit point in the field.

name: Beacon Surge
description: Pour the beacon's steady light into an ally to quicken his limbs and steady his guard.

name: Beacon Mend
description: Rest the warm light of the beacon on a hurt ally until the pain fades and the flesh closes.

name: Beacon Flare
description: Flare the beacon to full height in one blaze that scorches all foes close about it.

name: Beacon Cover
description: Spread the beacon's light over yourself and your allies as a bright cover against heavy blows.

name: Beacon Summons
description: Raise the beacon high and call every ally in the field to strength and one purpose.

name: Wayfinder Fist
description: Throw a straight punch along a line fixed on one star so it never wanders from the mark.

name: Wayfinder Ward
description: Fix the guard on its star and let nothing move it from the bearing.

name: Wayfinder Step
description: Walk the line to the fixed star in steps that never drift left or right.

name: Wayfinder Turn
description: Keep the bearing and turn only the forearm to push a blow off the line.

name: Wayfinder Mark
description: Mark the foe with a faint star so his place is known to you wherever he moves.

name: Wayfinder Spear
description: Drive a spear of starlight down the fixed line through the foe's guard.

name: Wayfinder Mend
description: Guide a steady stream of starlight along a wound to close it in yourself or an ally.

name: Wayfinder Volley
description: Loose bolts of starlight that all fly true to the fixed mark.

name: Wayfinder Dash
description: Dash a long line to the fixed star in one bright rush and arrive on balance.

name: Wayfinder Leap
description: Cross the field along the fixed line in a single bright leap with no step between.

name: Gnomon Palm
description: Strike with a palm that stands straight as a gnomon and casts its force along one line.

name: Gnomon Guard
description: Stand a straight post of qi before the body so a blow splits to either side.

name: Gnomon Step
description: Pivot round the fixed foot so the long shadow of the stance sweeps to a new line.

name: Gnomon Turn
description: Let a strike break on the upright post of the arm and fall along its shadow.

name: Gnomon Sight
description: Cast the long shadow of the post across the foe and read where his weight is thin.

name: Gnomon Pierce
description: Drive the post of qi along the shadow's line into the weakest place found.

name: Gnomon Cleanse
description: Cast a clean shadow of starlight over a tainted wound and draw the taint out of it.

name: Gnomon Barrage
description: Throw a rank of posts of light along the shadow's line that strike the same weak point.

name: Gnomon Brace
description: Brace a gnomon at each flank so heavy blows are caught between the upright posts.

name: Gnomon Strike
description: Land one blow on the exact point the shadow marks so it wounds from within past any guard.

name: Zodiac Palm
description: Strike with a palm that turns through one house of the wheel and lands with its full sweep.

name: Zodiac Ward
description: Turn the wheel before the body and let each house take a share of the blow.

name: Zodiac Step
description: Pass from house to house of the wheel in a smooth turning stride about the foe.

name: Zodiac Turn
description: Spin a blow round the wheel to the next house and out past the shoulder.

name: Zodiac Draw
description: Draw strength from the house that stands highest in the wheel into the arms and legs.

name: Zodiac Disrupt
description: Turn the wheel against the rhythm of the foe's qi so his technique breaks off mid-cast.

name: Zodiac Pierce
description: Send one spoke of the wheel straight through the guard and into the body.

name: Zodiac Mend
description: Turn the wheel to the house of mending and let its light close a wound in an ally.

name: Zodiac Sweep
description: Sweep the whole wheel round at once and strike every foe at the rim.

name: Zodiac Cover
description: Turn the wheel over yourself and your allies as a cover that shares a blow among all its houses.

name: Zodiac Turning
description: Turn the great wheel across the field so every foe is thrown from his course and struck as it passes.
